gameTopfive.title: Top Five
gameTopfive.intro: A ranking criterion is given. Pick the top 5 in order, from 1st to 5th. Choose from the candidate list and place them in the correct positions.
gameTopfive.mobileRuleSummary: Tap a candidate to place it → reorder with arrows → submit when all 5 slots are filled
gameTopfive.notEnoughData: Not enough data to generate a puzzle
gameTopfive.fixtureMode: ⚠ Demo Mode — running on sample data
gameTopfive.instruction: Select the top 5 from the candidates below and place them 1st through 5th
gameTopfive.selectHere: ← Select a candidate below to place here

rules.rankBody: Place the top 5 in order from 1st to 5th according to today's criterion.
rules.pickBody: Choose 5 from 12 candidates. No free typing — pick from the list so spelling is never an issue.
rules.scoreBody: Exact position = 20 pts. In top 5 but wrong spot = 10 pts. Perfect score is 100.
